The full test suite passes: **259 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors**.

## Summary

I implemented the requirement that creating an owner is rejected with **409 Conflict** when another owner already has the same last name **and** the same telephone number.

**Change made** — `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

The `addOwner` handler already routed through an `isDuplicateOwner(...)` check that returned `HttpStatus.CONFLICT`, but it matched on *all* fields (first name, last name, address, city, telephone). I narrowed the match to just last name + telephone, per the spec:

```java
private boolean isDuplicateOwner(Owner owner) {
    return this.clinicService.findOwnerByLastName(owner.getLastName()).stream()
        .anyMatch(existing ->
            Objects.equals(existing.getLastName(), owner.getLastName())
                && Objects.equals(existing.getTelephone(), owner.getTelephone()));
}
```

**Tests added** — `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.java`:
- `createOwnerDuplicateLastNameAndTelephoneReturnsConflict` — pre-existing owner with same last name + telephone → expects 409, even with different first name/address/city.
- `createOwnerSameLastNameDifferentTelephoneSucceeds` — same last name but different telephone → expects 201 (confirms only the last-name+telephone combination is blocked).

(Note: the V2 owner controller has no `addOwner` endpoint, so no change was needed there.)
